verdict.rationale: MX is a financial-data connectivity and API platform, not an AI agent or host app, so acting as an MCP client that loads external MCP servers' tools is outside its product role. The probe shows MX publishes its own official MCP server (mx-probe-3), but that is the server role and does not make this client-side axis applicable. Nothing in the pack shows MX can connect to or use third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
